verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software platform, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is outside its product category. The pack shows no developer API. The probes found no OpenAPI or llms.txt files (all 404s), which fits that category rather than showing a missing feature. Its use of AI and a blockchain trading platform is internal tooling, not a client-facing API.
